item.title: Impression of Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia
item.description:
When my homeland has been robbed, I gradually begin to feel pleasure.
I hate myself. Maybe I just want to forget, forget the life in the sands, forget my script and jujubes, forget the sound like the thunder that can frighten everyone. Just with the wind, steppes and horses, beneath the dome, then I lose the ability of longing. I will keep restraining myself, restraining till I lose my obsession.
